findings.title: A negative flusher process count disables flushing entirely
findings.body: `max_processes` is supplied by the new `--flusher-processes` option, which accepts negative integers. A negative value is truthy, so this expression preserves it; `min()` then makes `num_processes` negative, causing the following `range(self.num_processes)` to create no workers. The consumer can continue writing spans to Redis, but no flusher will ever publish buffered segments, leading to an unbounded Redis backlog and missing downstream span data. Reject non-positive values or clamp them to a valid count.
